description: This Java source file defines a class 'MessagingIntentService' which extends 'IntentService'. It handles asynchronous messaging reply actions initiated from notifications, updating messaging notifications with new replies, and recreating notification builders to preserve state after process kills. The class integrates with Android's notification system, specifically to handle messaging-style notifications with reply actions.

classes.name: MessagingIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService for handling messaging reply actions from notifications, updating messaging notifications with new messages, and restoring notification state after process death.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents, checks for reply action, and delegates to handleActionReply.

methods.name: handleActionReply
methods.description: Processes the user's reply from the notification, adds the message to messaging style, and updates the notification.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the reply message CharSequence from the intent's RemoteInput.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithMessagingStyle
methods.description: Recreates the notification builder with messaging style data, supporting notification updates after process death.
